purpose: Calibrate LMR authority after channel ablations while preserving the promoted adaptive-futility response.
hypothesis: Adaptive futility appears to carry most of the observed point-estimate gain. Halving LMR modulation may retain complementary deep-search information while reducing overcorrection from the full-strength LMR channel.
comparison: official-stockfish/Stockfish master fetched at run start
decision_rule: Do not promote from point estimate alone. Compare against the promoted baseline under the exact runtime Stockfish SHA and retain only if evidence is meaningfully favorable or warrants confirmation.
